title: Connection failures on auth-svc
impact: Requests failed while connections were refused on auth-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] auth-svc 2026-03-17 19:48-00:18: auth-svc: 295 of 384 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-17 19:48 and 2026-03-18 00:18 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: health check took <*> s (target group timeout 2 s)

_templates.macro: Terraform change cut the {svc} target-group health-check timeout {old} -> {new} s; targets under load flapped unhealthy and the ALB returned 502.

rca.macro: Terraform change cut the auth-svc target-group health-check timeout 5 -> 2 s; targets under load flapped unhealthy and the ALB returned 502.
rca.micro: infra/auth-svc.tf:69 sets health_check timeout 5 -> 2 on aws_lb_target_group.auth_svc.
rca.remediation: Restore the health-check timeout = 5 on aws_lb_target_group.auth_svc.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `received SIGTERM, draining connections (target deregistered)`.
